description: Every PoS validator and Storeman node with its profile fields (stake as exact WAN strings, APR, fee, room, delegators, status). Filter by type and status; sort by stake, apr, fee, room or delegators (fee ascending, the rest descending; fee and room are PoS only). Exited PoS validators (status exit, live stake 0) follow the live rows, newest exit first; status exit returns only them.
